name: quickshell-site
description: The public site for Quickshell. The copy lives in one module and the sections only render it.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/og-image.mjs && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.prerender: vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs
